Bill.BriefDescription: Adopting a schedule for establishing instream flows by rule.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the work plan for instream flow setting through2010; and adding a new section to chapter 90.54 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state adopts as its recommended schedule for establishinginstream flows by rule the schedule for setting such flows contained inthe December 12, 2002, document prepared by the department entitled"Work Plan for Instream Flow Setting Through 2010."
